### Observed differences

- In the later window, A06 appears in about 57% of traces (up from 22%), with mean occurrences per trace rising from 0.24 to 0.60. [OCC001]
- A08 appears in about 8% of traces (down from 22%), with mean occurrences per trace falling from 0.23 to 0.08. [OCC002]
- Activities A19, A20, A25, and A26, essentially absent before (0–0.5% of traces), appear in 30.5%, 26.5%, 21.5%, and 23.5% of traces respectively. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- A06's outgoing transitions concentrate on A15 (from 21% to 90% of its transitions). [DIR001]
- A14's outgoing transitions shift from mostly A15 (83%) to A06 (53%) and A15 (45%). [DIR003]
- A42's outgoing transitions shift from mostly A27 (82%) to A19 (30%), A20 (24%), A26 (22%), and A25 (19%). [DIR007]
- The new activities A20, A25, A26 go to A27 in 88–96% of their transitions. [DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- A06's mean relative position moves earlier, from 0.43 to 0.18. [POS001]
- The new activities A20, A25, A26 appear at relative positions around 0.37–0.40. [POS002, POS003, POS004]
- Co-occurrence of A06 with A14, A15, A27, and A42 rises from 22% to 57% of traces. [REL001, REL002, REL007, REL008]
- Ordering changes: A14 before A06 rises from 19% to 53%; A06 before A15 from 2.5% to 29.5%; A06 before A27 from 14% to 51.5%; A06 before A42 from 9.5% to 53%. [REL001, REL002, REL007, REL008]
- The new activities appear after A14, A15, and A06: e.g., A14 before A19 rises from 0.5% to 30%, A14 before A20 from 0% to 26%, A14 before A25 from 0% to 21.5%, A14 before A26 from 0.5% to 23.5%. [REL009-012]
- The new activities appear before A27: A19 before A27 30%, A20 before A27 25%, A25 before A27 21.5%, A26 before A27 22.5%. [REL020, REL024, REL027, REL029]
- A42 appears before the new activities: A42 before A19 30.5%, A42 before A20 26%, A42 before A25 21%, A42 before A26 23%. [REL021, REL025, REL028, REL030]
- Lag distributions shift accordingly: e.g., A14 to A06 lag becomes mostly 1 (from 53% to 96%); A15 to A27 lag moves from mostly 4 to mostly 5 (from 69% to 99%); A42 to A27 lag moves from mostly 1 to mostly 2 (from 82% to 92%). [LAG002, LAG005, LAG007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process was restructured to include a new set of activities (A19, A20, A25, A26) that are executed after A42 and before A27, while A06 becomes more frequently executed and appears earlier in the trace, and A08 becomes less frequent. This is supported by the appearance of these activities in the later window, their routing to A27, the routing of A42 to them, and the relational/lag data showing the order A42 → new activities → A27, as well as A14 → A06 → A15. The main competing explanation, that these differences arise from sampling variation in variant frequencies, is unlikely given the large number of consistent indicators, but cannot be entirely ruled out. [OCC003-006, DIR003, DIR004-007, REL009-012, REL020-030, LAG002, LAG005, LAG007]
